guide_solution: Match Column A, Column B and Column C: (a) Morality develops the conscience by which man can judge good or bad and right or wrong. (b) It helps a man guide himself in a proper way and cultivate all the virtues to become a complete man. (c) It is such a great natural power that it grows naturally in human behaviour which cannot ignore logic and reason. (d) But nowadays, moral erosion is increasing and we are losing the invaluable virtue of morality. (e) If we do not practise morality from our childhood, we shall fall in every aspect of life.
